title.narrative: Bulk Procurement of Medicine to the GoM- Phase 2

description.narrative: This project aims to establish effective systems for a centralized, evidence-based procurement mechanism in Maldives, to ensure transparent, quality, cost-efficient and sustainable public procurement. With rising fiscal pressures and significant health-related procurement expenditures, the project will build on the flagship partnership with UNDP Maldives through the 2023-2024 Project Initiation Plan (PIP) “Supporting the Government of Maldives to procure medicines at scale for driving efficiency gains, and to ensure financial sustainability of the Maldives Universal Health Coverage Scheme” enhancing government capacities for large-scale procurement and institutional strengthening.Key outputs of this project include: (1) Fiscal savings generated through bulk procurement of essential items for public sector.(2) Institutional capacities of the Central Procurement Department (CPD) strengthened.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
